scope: v0.2 desktop product flow for D1 exact duplicates: choose a keeper and preview Keep/Move in the standard read-only build; exercise a clearly labelled synthetic quarantine/restore loop; keep the native prototype behind default-off internal gates while advanced evidence and export remain secondary

platform_matrix.implementation_stack_version: Tauri 2.11.x; React 19.2.8; TypeScript 6.0.2; Rust 1.77.2 and 1.92.0 validation toolchains
platform_matrix.design_guidance: User-centred local photo workbench, repository safety model, platform-app guidance, and native macOS interaction conventions
platform_matrix.fallback_notes: Only one explicitly selected D1 group can enter a read-only plan. Standard builds never execute quarantine or restore and return QUARANTINE_RELEASE_GATE_CLOSED. The internal prototype remains test-only; unknown filesystem capability, sidecar ambiguity, non-independent members, path or mount identity change, content drift, restore conflict, or journal uncertainty fails closed. Reading may update filesystem-managed atime.

direction.name: 中性本地照片工作台
direction.north_star: 每一屏都回答用户现在可以安全做什么：选择保留项、看清 Keep/Move 计划，并在写入门禁未完成时明确停在只读预览。
direction.signature_device: Keep / Move 双轨贯穿成员选择、计划预览、隔离结果与恢复状态。

entrypoints.open_instructions: From the repository root run pnpm install, then pnpm tauri:dev. No current .app or .dmg is retained or claimed by this delivery record.
Open design-direction.md together with the repository design-system/tokens.tokens.json and src/App.css implementation.

design_direction.notes: The implemented cool-neutral workbench, Keep/Move signature, three-direction comparison, rejected warm-paper archive anti-reference, provenance, states, and safety language are documented.

token_source.notes: Canonical repository source is design-system/tokens.tokens.json; v0.2 replaces the rejected warm-paper/forest-green bundle with cool neutrals, cobalt action, emerald Keep and violet Move roles.

token_export.notes: Canonical generated target export is src/styles/tokens.css; pnpm tokens:check verifies synchronization.

contrast_evidence.notes: Representative opaque role pairs cover body text, controls, focus, and warning text.

component_source.notes: Production component and state source is src/App.tsx with styling in src/App.css and src/index.css.

accessibility.notes: Repository tests/ui/app.spec.ts owns axe and keyboard checks; VoiceOver manual coverage is explicitly limited.

icon_source.notes: Functional icons use lucide-react under ISC; the original app icon is generated from design-system/assets/guiying-app-icon.svg and configured for macOS and Windows sizes. No current bundle is claimed.

implementation_source.notes: Production sources are src, src-tauri, and the guiying core, metadata, runtime, store, time, and volume crates; this package records the handoff without copying those sources.

image_generation.notes: The interface is implemented directly from the product safety model; no generated UI raster reference is used.

browser_rendering.notes: The in-app browser rendered the default read-only landing and exercised explicitly labelled synthetic review, plan, quarantine and restore states at 1280x820 plus the 1024x768 review boundary.

figma.notes: No Figma artifact was requested; the canonical implementation and design system live in the repository.

native_runner.notes: This iteration did not build a Tauri bundle or perform a native run. Native visual, responsive, runtime and end-to-end targets therefore remain explicit limitations; historical bundle/run logs and the archived M0 screenshot are not reused as current evidence.

image_inspection.notes: The rejected user screenshot and new review screenshot were inspected together; new plan and completion captures were also inspected at original size. The review preserves context while replacing the dead-end evidence/export hierarchy with an actionable keeper decision and read-only plan; the reversible execution shown in browser evidence is explicitly synthetic.

qa.notes: Frontend production build, lint, DTCG synchronization and manual in-app-browser flow/compact visual checks passed. Rust quarantine/restore gates are recorded after the native service run. Current native bundle visuals, real external-volume fault matrix and VoiceOver remain explicit limitations.

sources.notes: Repository provenance, dependency licenses, non-copy boundaries, and synthetic-data hygiene are recorded.

handoff.notes: Stack mapping, source ownership, commands, capability boundaries, and milestone constraints are recorded.
